user.title: Pair with your BRAM Server
user.description: Open the BRAM Server's config page, press Get code, and paste the code here.

error.invalid_code: That code is wrong, expired, or already used.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach that server, or it is not the one that made this code.

init.title: BRAM options
init.description: BRAM only sees the entities you choose, and cannot control anything. Leak and smoke alerts come from Home Assistant itself and ignore quiet hours. They do not replace certified alarms.

data.escalate: After 5 minutes without an answer, also send leak and smoke alerts through Telegram and ntfy
